leads.name: Starkeiche im Rosental (Auwald)
leads.why: Often called Leipzig's oldest and stoutest tree. monumentale-eichen.de (Rainer Lippert, private survey, measured 2017): girth 6.65 m at breast height, 9.50 m at ground, ~27 m tall, crown ~20 m, hollow with a 1 m wide opening, vitality 'ok' in 2017; age 350 (survey and baumkunde.de register 5221) vs 600 (press) years. Not an ND and no authority register record found, so not RICH; pin is a survey coordinate in dense floodplain forest (Rosental), not confirmed on the trunk; no openly licensed photo checked. Strongest Leipzig candidate if a photo or OSM node is found. Alive 2017 only (lifecheck not run). Access: Rosental is a public park/forest with paths, unverified for the tree itself. 2026-10-18 verify pass: DELIVERED as lpz_026 (confirmed pin: OSM information board 4 m away, baumkunde GPS within 2 m, alive March 2024, 6.69 m girth Dec 2021). No open photograph exists on Commons.

leads.why: Already published as lpz_029 (The Oaks of Doelitz Torhaus); write pass 2026-10-18. Public city green, lifecheck RECENT (iNaturalist 2026-04-26) but no photograph of either trunk in reach (Commons files nearby show the war memorial and Torhaus); the war memorial register entry mentions a Friedenseiche planted 1872 plus two later oaks, so which trunk is which is unsettled and the 570 cm girth does not fit an 1872 planting.
